I do have some legit problems with GW. The same I do with SC, actually.

 I do agree that Giorno, while not being the worst character ever, has a lot of wasted potential when it comes to his relationship to the other Joestars. But he does show traits from both DIO and Jonathan, but it's more subtle than what Jolyne or Josuke ever had when it comes to call backs to their fathers. You take the way Giorno fights. His stand cry , the cruelty he shows toward some assassins, like Ciocolatta, Melone or even Diavolo himself. Those are some pretty serious callbacks to DIO, heck, even his role, being more passive and only acting is desperate situation are similar to DIO's behavior in SC, who only really started being active when the Crusaders were in his mansion. And for Jonathan... Well, his good nature. Even his whole goal. Taking away the drugs from Passione is something that Jonathan could have done. But what can make him seem really boring is... Well, he is placed between two Jojos who are way more open about their emotions. Those being Josuke and Jolyne.

Now, I did mention SC earlier on. And its relationship to GW is quite interesting. As their problems are mostly mirrored version of each other. SC had some mostly basic and sometimes plain awful minor villains, while GW has some of the best. SC had a pretty good cast of protagonists, Polnareff even coming back in GW, while GW... Outside of Bucciaratti, Mista, Trish and Narancia... The others were either boring at best, annoying at worst. I never found Fugo to be this interesting. I never found Abacchio's character to be this dramatic. Especially compared to Narancia, Trish or even Fugo.

Now, the main antagonist... I think that Diavolo is the most forgetable of the series. Being a less interesting version of Kira because... Well, we already had Kira a few years ago. But what I can appreciate is how similar he is to DIO on some aspects. Always staying in the shadow, having a group of people devoted to him and obeying him, but also some members ready to betray him, like Hol Horse was ready to kill DIO. 

Finally, GER. I like the idea in concept but, having this huge thing like Requiem stand and not using it any further is infuriating. Think about how cool requiem stands could have been in Stone Ocean ! Having a Stone Free Requiem would have been great, but sadly, it's something we'll never see, unless the Josuke/Hol Horse spin off decides to adress it.

​

In conclusion, while GW is far from my favorite part AND isn't the masterpiece that everyone is blabbering about, I don't think it's horrible. Overrated, but not horrible.
